title: [finding] service-automation's DST-offset test timed out at the default 5000 ms on a contended runner and reddened an unrelated PR — each cell switches process.env.TZ, and the whole file's tests took 27 s against 498 s of import
body:
① — a flaky test that reddened an unrelated PR's required check.

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (seat post #6017, `session_013RDBh5DqXd2xnLwvHLgLFr`). ⛔ Unlabelled beyond `finding`, ⛔ ungraded, ⛔ unrouted. Suggested lane: `domain:services`. The lane rule is 「谁发现 flake 谁修或立单,⛔ 不绕行」 and the file is outside this seat's lane, so this is the filing half.

## What failed — read first-hand from the job log

`Test Core (3/6)` on PR #19752 at head `c06eec4029`, run 35799036431, job 106984977747:

```
FAIL src/builtin/template-date-offset-dst.test.ts > #14852 {TODAY() +/- n} resolves on one calendar,
     across DST transitions > spring-forward: Asia/Jerusalem @ … (Sat 2026-03-28 02:30 IDT) {TODAY() - 1}
Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.
 ❯ src/builtin/template-date-offset-dst.test.ts:138:9
Test Files  1 failed | 140 passed (141)
Tests       1 failed | 1689 passed (1690)
Duration    193.68s (transform 31.71s, setup 0ms, import 498.00s, tests 27.24s, environment 53ms)
```

The same shard ran `@objectstack/cli:build`, `@objectstack/verify:build` and `@objectstack/runtime:test` concurrently in that window (their lines interleave in the log).

## Why it is not the PR's

The PR changes ADR-0087 migration-entry prose, a regenerated registry and a changeset; this package's tests are package-local. Two later heads of the same PR ran this shard **green**, and the round that diagnosed it reproduced the **exact** merge tree CI tested (`git merge-tree --write-tree c06eec4029 2bdb81f8ad`) with the package's suite passing (141 files / 1690 tests). ⇒ non-deterministic on that runner.

## What the test does, read at source (`origin/main`)

One `it()` per `DST_CELLS` entry. Each goes through `at(zone, instant, fn)` (`:70`), which sets `process.env.TZ = zone`, calls `vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'] })` and `vi.setSystemTime(…)`, and restores the real `TZ` afterwards. The file header explains why it must switch zones: the defect it pins is invisible at `TZ=UTC`.

⚠️ **Hypothesis, ⛔ not measured**: changing `process.env.TZ` makes V8 re-read time-zone data on the next `Date` operation, so the first cell to enter a given zone may pay a zone-data load; on a runner spending 498 s importing, that could plausibly cross 5000 ms for one cell while the whole file's tests total 27 s. ⛔ This seat did not time a cell and does not claim the mechanism.

## ⛔ What is NOT claimed

- ⛔ No repair chosen — a per-file or per-`it` timeout, pre-warming each zone outside the timed body, or a different isolation are all coherent, and the owner decides.
- ⛔ Not the `engine.test.ts` wall-clock assertion (#19766): that card first named itself a *candidate* for this red, and the log shows it was not the one that failed. The two are separate defects.

## Related, ⛔ not duplicates

- **#19631** — the same family (a default-5000 ms timeout reddening an unrelated PR on a contended runner), a different file (`plugin-dev`'s `dev-plugin-tenancy-posture.test.ts`). 同族异缺陷 ⇒ cross-linked, ⛔ not merged; whether they share one systemic remedy is triage's call.
- **#19766** — the phantom wall-clock check in the same package; the card this one corrects the provenance of.

**Dedupe words**: `template-date-offset-dst` · `Test timed out in 5000ms` · `process.env.TZ` · `DST_CELLS` · `service-automation flake`
